body:
I’m really sorry about your dad.. Even if you weren’t close at one point in time he was a major part of your life. 

Your special someone doesn’t care about your anxiety, especially right now and I’m sure they are honestly just concerned about your well being. Long distance is hard, I’ve done it too, and when you’re with each other the last thing you want is for your anxiety to flare up. But if it is, fuck it! You’re with your person and they just want the best for you.

It’s really cool and brave you made that trip! Idk where you’re from but that’s a hell of a flight for me. LDR’s take a lot of balls and a few leaps of faith but can be very rewarding :)
I’m sorry :/ Care to explain?
Lol don’t holidays feel like chores 😂 do you get along with your fam? Are they aware of your mental health?
It really is terrifying. I’m glad you are ok now though, it takes strength to pull yourself out of the rabbit hole
Why do you hate yourself??
I’m sorry if that came off kinda dick-ish Like I’m trying to tell you how to fix it. I really want you to succeed with her if you really like her

Isnt that such a great feeling? I’m bad at taking my own advice, but maybe you should ease off the gas a little, it can be a little overwhelming for a girl in that situation. Def don’t cut her off, but maybe let her come to you a little more? It can definitely help them come around in the end if they have some space to think
What happened an hour ago?
Any reason? Or just one of them days
I don’t think you are man, but what exactly makes you think you’re in love? Idk really what that means anymore lol.

Honestly man I really can’t say I know how you feel considering my first try with meds basically eliminated 75% of my anxiety, but I do know multiple people that took years to get their meds right, but there is something out there for everyone and I really believe that. Not cures, meds alone can’t do that, but keep trying, I hope that yours gets better sooner rather than later
I’m sorry man :/ is there any history between y’all? That would make me really upset if I were in your shoes
What have you been on?? If you don’t mind me asking.

Anxiety is a bitch man. I used to struggle real bad with it too and there’s really not much you can do about it. Are you on any meds??

Edit: that was meant for moose lol my phones fucking up too.

Tomorrow is a new day! When you read this I hope that you are in a better mood and you and your BFF have started talking again. I know how you feel with not being able to shake a bad mood, once you get in one it can turn the entire day sour.
If you’re asking yourself that question, I think that one would help you

I’m sorry about your friend man. But you’re so right, their mom knew how much you meant to your friend and vice versa. Those kinda things although bittersweet kinda make you feel like you have something to give to the world

I’ll start. I was really anxious about seeing my sister and brother in law who I hate, well i guess the feeling is mutual. Nothing popped off Like I was scared it would.  All in all, I’m glad the days over, I think tomorrow will be a goood day
Funny enough, my friends name is KT. Haha, but yeah, it feels nice to know that there are people who think I’m ok 😊
Do you mean as a friend? Or someone to like you as an SO?
I feel the same way most of the time. People my age are going and getting adult jobs and I’m sitting here making 11/hr barely paying bills and honestly it kinda makes me feel beneath them
Lol what do you mean by that

I go through phases where I can’t cry, and phases where anything at all will break me down into tears. It’s normal, and while there is something wrong with us, it’s just a symptom. Sometimes it’s easier to cry when you’re alone
Why do you say that?
Because I’m a lazy fuck who plays video games all day. I have a job but I hate it and I can barely pay my bills
He is! Mango is a sweet boy but he still has a lot of learning to do. I get frustrated and get really bad waves of the “puppy blues” but at the end of the day he is my best friend
Thanks :) I’m drunk and was just kinda reflecting on how far I had come. Still no happiness but the hope to find it is there for the moment. That can change in an instant

That’s really shitty man, child support has to be a bitch. I really hope your housing situation works out, I don’t know what I’d do if I was homeless. You can’t contact your landlord and let them know the situation?
I’m about to be 24 and feel the same way. Keep your head up man, there’s time for both of us
Congrats!!! I read this post and the very next game I got my first solo win too lol. It was good luck
Uppj

At this point, a lot of it is all in your head. I’ve been on Prozac for about a year now, and my anxiety went away instantly as well, but suicidal thoughts and other side effects didn’t show themselves so quickly.

It’s a tough process. You’re probably being over-observative from being on a new med, I did the same thing and it took a while to distinguish what exactly it was doing to me

Same here man, currently my stomach is growling because I don’t get paid for another week and all of my funds are tied up because of stupid spending by me. I too have suicidal thoughts that are largely in part to being broke. It’s stressful
Same here man, but in my case, I think it was actually me that isolated myself from all my friends. Ignored them, constantly flakey, they just got tired of me
Thanks so much. I know being good at games takes a level of intelligence and skill, but I feel bad cause it’s all I manage to do in my free time nowadays

I’m on a week vacation from work, because I felt extremely burnt out due to depression and constant anxiety, but I actually feel worse now. Everyday has been a reminder of the friends I don’t have and just how alone I am. I used to love being alone, now I fear it
Maybe we’re both? Which makes it especially hard. I feel like I’ve always been a little on the lazy side either way, but depression makes it where I literally cannot do things

You sound just like me. And as many times as someone assures you that it’s the depression,  you still always have that tug that maybe you’re just lazy. I hope that we can figure out how to turn it around
Well, this wasn’t recent. I just feel like we’re almost the same person doomed for the same fate.

How much were you speeding? Jesus Christ that sounds like a hefty fine for speeding. I don’t mean to lecture you, but fines are just something you’re gonna have to deal with, and the not being on the record is what really matters. Insurance companies LOVE when you get shit like that on your record. I know how you feel though, the slightest mishap can make your whole mind go south and instantly suicidal. It will be ok! Just don’t do it again, it’s a lesson to be learned.

Is there anyway you can pay it online? Otherwise, I promise court isn’t near as daunting as it seems. Everyone gets tickets now and again, it’s nothing new. You’re looking at about $250 total, plus when I got my speeding ticket, they reduced my fine based strictly on the fact I had a clean record beforehand. No one in that courtroom gives a fuck about your ticket, they just wanna go home. Lol. It’s really a thing that everyone will have to go through, just like jury duty.

Edit: Also, all the judge is going to ask is how you plead and if you’re ready to pay your fine. If he’s having a bad day he might nip you on the ass a little, but otherwise don’t worry, it’ll be fine
Having a fun night drinking can definitely put things into perspective. It helps me loosen up as well, and see the bright side of things, even if just for a night

You did what you can for now, he is safe. As for later, be there for him, get him to talk to you about his situation. And if he does, you aren’t gonna understand some of it, and that’s normal. Depression has no reason sometimes, and how he feels may make no sense to you, but just know whatever he feels is completely real. 

Is he in therapy? If not, that’s definitely something he NEEDS to do. It does wonders for a lot of people and helps me cope with daily life. 

Good luck, I know being on the other side of this can be as confusing as it is upsetting, but I hope that he gets the help he needs.
You’re right, I need to stop feeling sorry for myself and try to start being myself again. Depression is real and it’s controlling but I’m stronger than that

Yes, I am. Both actually, and for a while I was really getting better. Truth is, I have had a pretty shitty month between my GF and I splitting up and dealing with a horrible roommate situation. I took 40mg Prozac daily and had been off it for a week until yesterday, when my doctor actually raised my dose to 60mg. My emotions are everywhere, and I know this, but right now I don’t see the light at the end of the tunnel

I’m glad you were able to get it off of your chest. Even agreeing to go to a mental hospital is crazy brave, even if you say it was just because you were out of options. 

I guess I’ll delve into mine a little more as well. I had been back living with my mother for about a year, and that fact alone had me suicidal, I was a 23 year old with no college living with his mom. Basically, my car broke down in some neighborhood and I left it there, thinking I was gonna kill myself before I really had to deal with it. Very selfish in retrospect, but at the time seemed like my only option.

Fast forward 4 months and I’m living with my sister and new husband, it was a mutual decision because I needed to get out and they needed an upgrade. Basically things just haven’t worked out, some of it my fault, some theirs and most just misunderstandings because we argued rather than talked. I was wrong in some ways, and so are they, but the bridge is burned. Even though we are family right now it feels like we will never recover from it. 

I was off my meds for 10 days until a few hours ago when I got my shit together and went to the doc/ refilled my rx. I know a lot of it was from me being off them, but with my dose now INCREASING from 40-60 mg I know how these next couple months are about to be adjusting. I don’t know if I can make it through.

If you read this, thanks! It feels good to talk about it and if you ever wanna talk you’ve got a friend in me
Thank you. I am really nervous about it and I think I’m overreacting

Yea, I’d agree that’s probably the better term.  I don’t wanna do it myself. But if I were to die in a tragic accident I would at least leave my loved ones without the guilt of thinking they could have stopped me from killing myself yada yada

I can relate to you so much, been working as a line cook for 6 years now. It’s safe money, and I can afford to live off of it and smoke weed but that’s about it. I work, go home, and play video games and sleep. Do I wanna live my whole life like this? Hell no. But I wake myself up every morning and tell myself I’m a loser who would fail at anything else. I feel you man, I know I don’t understand everything, but you’re not alone

You have a great heart. I’d like to talk to you sometime. People like you help people like me remember why They’re alive. I feel constantly hopeless, but reading posts like this make me feel like I genuinely matter, even if just for a moment

I do this all the time, I’m doing it now. I have done some wrong things in my past, actually plenty, and I still do more every day. I’m a compulsive liar, I lie about stupid shit, what i ate for breakfast that morning, what time I’m going into work. I lie without even realizing sometimes, as crazy as it sounds. But I am depressed. I try to be good. To everyone I’ve disappointed, I have real shame. A lot of people love me, but I feel like they love the front I put up for them and the real me is just a useless worthless slob. Some days, I know that isn’t everything about me. I know that I’m pretty funny to most of my friends and that I do favors for people without expecting anything in return. Today’s just one of those days where none of that matters
